help.title: Dashboard Guide
help.intro: Welcome to your health dashboard! Each card helps you manage different aspects of your health. Here's what each one does:

cards.healthJournal: Shows your next medication reminder. Tap to see all your upcoming reminders and manage your medication schedule.
cards.labsLocations: Find nearby medical labs and testing centers. Shows distance from your location and provides directions to help you get there.
cards.pharmacyLocations: Find pharmacies near you with real-time distance calculations. Shows how far each pharmacy is and provides directions to help you get there.
cards.reminders: Set and manage medication reminders. Get notified when it's time to take your medications, refill prescriptions, or attend appointments.
cards.medications: Track all your medications, dosages, and schedules. Get refill reminders, check drug interactions, and manage your prescription history.
cards.herbs: Explore herbal remedies and natural supplements. Learn about benefits, dosages, and potential interactions with your medications.
cards.supplements: Manage your vitamins and supplements. Track daily intake, set reminders, and ensure you're getting the right nutrients.
cards.smartAlerts: Intelligent notifications that adapt to your routine. Get location-based reminders, weather alerts, and personalized health tips.
cards.healthAnalytics: Track your health metrics over time. Monitor medication adherence, side effects, and health trends with detailed charts and insights.
cards.appointmentLog: Schedule and manage doctor appointments. Store doctor contacts, track visit history, and never miss an important healthcare appointment.
cards.aiHealth: Explore general symptom, health and medication information with AI assistants. They are not doctors and do not provide medical advice.
cards.documents: Store and organize your medical documents. Keep insurance cards, lab results, prescriptions, and ID cards in one secure place for easy access during doctor visits.

help.tip: 💡 Tip: Tap any card to explore its features. The floating AI button opens a general health-information assistant. It is not a doctor.

herbReview.food: No major known risks in food amounts
herbReview.known: Known risk: avoid without medical supervision
herbReview.alert: According to {{source}}, {{herb}} may interact with {{medication}} on your list. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before combining them. Don't stop or change your medication on your own.
herbReview.noMatches: We found no interactions in our sources, but that doesn't guarantee it's safe. Ask your pharmacist.
herbReview.footer: General educational information. Not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation and not a substitute for advice from a health professional. Herbal products can cause side effects and interact with medicines. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, have a condition or take medicines, check with your doctor or pharmacist before using them.
herbReview.notReviewed: We do not have a reviewed NCCIH fact sheet specific to this plant. The NCCIH link provides general supplement information, not an assessment of this species.
herbReview.damiana: Traditionally used in folk medicine for digestive and mood-related concerns.
herbReview.uncertain: Scientific evidence is limited and does not confirm effectiveness for this use.
herbReview.pregnancyUnknown: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: risk information is insufficient.
herbReview.foodPregnancyUnknown: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: insufficient information for amounts greater than food amounts.
herbReview.generalPrecaution: Many supplements have not been tested in pregnant people, breastfeeding people or children. Tell your healthcare team before surgery; supplements may pose risks.
herbReview.bloodSugar: Diabetes: blood-sugar effects have been described; consult before using supplements.
herbReview.garlicPrecaution: Supplements may increase bleeding; tell your healthcare team before surgery. During pregnancy and breastfeeding, amounts above food amounts may pose risks. Raw garlic on skin can cause burns.
herbReview.chamomilePrecaution: May cause allergies, especially with allergies to related plants. May affect estrogen-sensitive conditions.
herbReview.aloePrecaution: Oral aloe may pose risks during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Oral latex may cause cramps and diarrhea; liver injury has been reported with leaf extracts.
herbReview.ginkgoPrecaution: During pregnancy may increase early labor or bleeding risk. Fresh seeds and crude plant material may cause serious effects.
herbReview.echinaceaPrecaution: May cause serious allergic reactions. Rashes have occurred in children: consult their clinician before use. Consult before using supplements during pregnancy.
herbReview.gingerPrecaution: May cause heartburn, diarrhea and mouth or throat irritation. Consult before using supplements during pregnancy; breastfeeding information is insufficient.
herbReview.turmericPrecaution: Supplements may pose risks during pregnancy. Some high-absorption curcumin formulations have been associated with liver injury.
herbReview.astragalusPrecaution: May worsen autoimmune diseases. Pregnancy and breastfeeding data are insufficient; animal studies suggest fetal harm.
herbReview.licoricePrecaution: Glycyrrhizin may cause serious heart rhythm problems, especially with hypertension or heart or kidney disease. High intake during pregnancy is associated with early delivery.
herbReview.cinnamonPrecaution: Cassia cinnamon contains coumarin; prolonged use may pose problems in people with liver disease.
herbReview.wortPrecaution: During pregnancy may increase birth defect risk. Infants exposed through breast milk may experience colic, drowsiness and lethargy.
herbReview.peppermintPrecaution: Do not apply peppermint oil to infants’ or young children’s faces: menthol may affect breathing. Oral oil may cause heartburn.
herbReview.lavenderPrecaution: Before surgery disclose use because of possible interactions with sedatives.
herbReview.aristolochiaPrecaution: Aristolochic acids may cause kidney damage and are associated with urinary tract cancer. Avoid products containing them.
herbReview.ingredientMissing: Some medicines have no recorded active ingredients and could not be checked. Add them in Medications.
herbReview.use_aroma: Traditionally used for aromatic and bathing practices.
herbReview.use_chinese: Traditionally used for traditional Chinese medicine practices.
herbReview.class_liverDrugs: Some liver-metabolized drugs; consult the source
herbReview.class_wortDrugs: Some antidepressants, contraceptives, cyclosporine, phenytoin, carbamazepine, digoxin, ivabradine, indinavir, nevirapine, irinotecan, imatinib, docetaxel, warfarin and simvastatin
herbReview.class_digoxin: Cardiac glycosides such as digoxin (oral aloe latex)

usLegal.global: AuricRX MedCoach provides general health information and reminders. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. It is not a substitute for advice from your doctor or pharmacist. In an emergency, call 911.
usLegal.ai: AI assistant, not a doctor or a human. Answers can be wrong. Check with your doctor or pharmacist before changing any medication.
usLegal.crisis: If you think you are having a medical emergency, call 911 now. If you are thinking about suicide or are in emotional distress, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). For a possible poisoning or overdose, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222.
usLegal.interactions: Shows reference information from official sources. Not personalized advice. Not seeing a notice doesn't mean a combination is safe. Always ask your pharmacist or doctor.
usLegal.herbs: Herbs and supplements are not reviewed by the FDA for safety or effectiveness. Evidence is limited. Tell your doctor or pharmacist about every supplement you take.
usLegal.wearables: For general wellness only. These numbers are not medical measurements and are not checked for problems. Talk to a doctor about any health concern.
usLegal.recalls: Adverse event reports are unverified and do not prove a drug caused a problem. Source: openFDA. Don't stop a medication without talking to your doctor.
usLegal.prices: Prices are estimates for information only, may be out of date, and are not an offer. Your actual cost depends on your pharmacy, insurance, and quantity. Confirm with the pharmacy.
usLegal.nadac: NADAC is the average price pharmacies pay to buy a drug, published weekly by CMS (data.medicaid.gov). It is not what you will pay at the pharmacy and does not include dispensing fees or insurance. CMS does not endorse this app. Data as of [date].
usLegal.nlm: This product uses publicly available data courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health, Department of Health and Human Services; NLM is not responsible for the product and does not endorse or recommend this or any other product.
usLegal.fda: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (https://open.fda.gov). FDA does not endorse this app.
usLegal.dailymed: Label information from DailyMed (dailymed.nlm.nih.gov), U.S. National Library of Medicine. Last updated [date].

privacyNotice.dataCollectedText: We collect account information (email, password), health data you enter (medications, reminders, appointments, documents, symptoms), and optional data from Health Connect if you grant permission. We do not collect data for advertising purposes.
privacyNotice.howWeUseText: We use your data only to provide the services you requested: reminders, health tracking, AI information assistance, Family Circle features, and optional cloud backup. We do not sell your health data or use it for targeted advertising.
privacyNotice.sharingText: We share data only with service providers necessary to operate the app (Firebase for authentication, cloud hosting for optional backup, OpenAI for AI chat you choose to send). We do not share your health data for marketing or advertising. Optional Family Circle features let you share with family members you invite.
privacyNotice.yourRightsText: You have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Object to the use of your personal data. You can export and delete your data at any time in Settings > Privacy. You can withdraw consent for cloud backup, Health Connect, or Family Circle features at any time.
privacyNotice.contactText:
[PRIVACY EMAIL – pending approval]

For questions about your privacy rights or to exercise them, please write to the email above.

cloudBackup.title: Cloud Backup
cloudBackup.premiumRequired: Cloud backup for documents requires Premium. Upgrade to sync your documents across devices.
cloudBackup.optInDescription: It's off. If you turn it on, we'll store a copy of the documents you choose (for example prescriptions, lab results and imaging reports), with their tags and notes, on servers of a cloud hosting provider located in [the United States], which works on behalf of [RESPONSABLE – pending owner approval] and may only use them to store your backup.
cloudBackup.whatStoredText: only the documents you mark for backup. We do not back up your Health Connect or Apple Health data.
cloudBackup.howProtectText: data is encrypted when it's sent and when it's stored, and can only be accessed from your account [and by people in your Family Circle with whom you choose to share it]. If a security incident affecting you occurs, we'll inform you immediately.
cloudBackup.yourChoiceText: you can turn off backup anytime in Settings > Backup. When you turn it off you can delete the cloud copies; we'll delete them within [X] days. Deleting your copies is free, even if you no longer have Pro.
cloudBackup.yourRightsText: you can access, rectify, cancel or object to the use of your data (ARCO rights) and withdraw your consent in Settings > Privacy or by writing to [PRIVACY EMAIL – pending approval]. See the Privacy Notice: [URL].
cloudBackup.consentCheckbox: I expressly consent to storing a cloud copy of the health documents I choose, under the terms above.
cloudBackup.enableButtonHelper: (enabled by checking the box and confirming your identity)
cloudBackup.lawfulRiskNote: Storing documents on the internet has risks that don't exist if you only store them on your phone. We remain responsible for protecting them. If you prefer, keep backup off: your documents will remain stored only on this phone.
cloudBackup.disableMessage: We won't upload new documents anymore.
cloudBackup.deleteCloudCheckbox: Also delete the copies that are already in the cloud (deleted within [X] days; copies on your phone are not deleted).
cloudBackup.reauthRequired: Please confirm your identity to enable cloud backup
cloudBackup.consentMessage: Your health documents will now be backed up to the cloud.
cloudBackup.deleteCloudDescription: Delete all cloud copies of your documents. Your local copies will remain on this device.
cloudBackup.deleteCloudSuccess: All cloud copies have been deleted.
cloudBackup.deleteCloudNotImplemented: Cloud deletion not yet implemented. This is a TODO for backend integration.
cloudBackup.disclaimer: Local documents always work even without cloud backup. Cloud backup is optional.

familyCircle.childNoLogin: Child profiles don't have login access and are excluded from AI by default.
familyCircle.alertDisclaimer: This alert is just a reminder. Confirm before giving any medication. If in doubt, call the primary caregiver.
familyCircle.alertStopsWhen: Alerts will stop when {{name}} leaves Family Circle or when the member who created the alert turns it off.
familyCircle.sharePreview: You're about to share a summary with health information from {{names}}. Use only with authorized people (family, caregivers). Continue?
familyCircle.membersDescription: Add profiles for family members who may not use the app themselves.
familyCircle.noMembers: No family members added yet. Add your first member to start tracking.

familyCircle.shareViaMessage: Select how you want to share this summary.
familyCircle.shareConsentMessage: You are about to share health information for a family member. This consent is valid for 7 days.

prevention.title: Checkup Reminders
prevention.description: Schedule yearly screenings, checkups, and vaccine reminders. These are reminders only and do not assess your individual risk.
prevention.disclaimer: Templates provide general guidance based on public health guidelines. They do not replace your doctor's recommendations or assess whether you personally need a test.

templates.glucoseScreeningDesc: Check blood sugar levels to screen for diabetes or prediabetes.
templates.bloodPressureDesc: Routine blood pressure measurement to screen for hypertension.
templates.generalCheckupDesc: Annual physical exam with your primary care doctor.
templates.cholesterolDesc: Lipid panel to check cholesterol and triglycerides.
templates.eyeExamDesc: Routine vision and eye health exam.

labOrganizer.title: Lab & Document Organizer
labOrganizer.documentsDescription: Your scanned medical documents are here. Tag them and organize by family member.
labOrganizer.noDocuments: No documents added yet. Use the Documents feature to scan or add files.
labOrganizer.documentsInfo: Note: Documents added through the main Documents screen will appear here once you tag them.
labOrganizer.labValuesDescription: Manually enter lab results to track trends over time.
labOrganizer.enterTestAndValue: Please enter both test name and value
labOrganizer.noInterpretation: ⚠️ This app does NOT interpret lab results, flag abnormal values, or provide reference ranges. Share your results with your doctor.
labOrganizer.glossaryDescription: Plain-language explanations of common lab tests.
labOrganizer.glossaryDisclaimer: For educational purposes only. Does not interpret your specific results.
labOrganizer.doctorQuestionsDescription: Keep a list of questions to ask during your next appointment.
labOrganizer.questionPlaceholder: What do you want to ask your doctor?

dailyHabits.title: Daily Habits
dailyHabits.noEntries: No entries yet. Start tracking today!
dailyHabits.entrySaved: Your daily entry has been saved!
dailyHabits.healthConnectDescription: With your permission, AuricRX MedCoach will read steps and sleep data from Health Connect (which may come from Samsung Health, Fitbit, Garmin, Mi Fitness, or other apps). We use this data only to show you your history and charts within the app. We do not diagnose. We do not sell this data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties. It stays on your phone and is not sent to our servers. You can revoke this permission anytime in Settings > Privacy or in Health Connect, and delete imported data.
dailyHabits.healthConnectDisclaimer: Data imported from your apps and devices for wellness purposes. May not be accurate. This is not a diagnosis and does not replace a doctor's assessment. If you feel unwell or have symptoms, seek medical care; in an emergency call 911.
dailyHabits.healthConnectGranted: Health Connect access granted! Your data will sync automatically.
dailyHabits.healthConnectDenied: Health Connect access was not granted. You can enable it later in Settings.
dailyHabits.healthConnectError: Unable to connect to Health Connect. Please try again.
dailyHabits.sweetDrinksDescription: Sugary drinks (sodas, sweetened juices, energy drinks) are relevant in Mexico due to food warning labels and public health campaigns. Track them to be aware of your intake.

privacy.title: Privacy & Your Data
privacy.promiseText: Your health data belongs to you. Here's what we do and don't do:
privacy.promise1: No ads. We don't use your health data for advertising.
privacy.promise2: Your data stays yours. We don't sell your information.
privacy.promise3: On-device storage. Your reminders and tracking data stay on your phone.
privacy.promise4: You control sharing. Premium features let you share summaries when you choose.
privacy.exportDescription: Download a copy of your data to keep or transfer.
privacy.exportDataMessage: This will create a file with your health data. You can save it or share it via WhatsApp or other apps.
privacy.exportSuccess: Your data has been exported successfully.
privacy.exportFailed: Failed to export data. Please try again.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanently delete all your health data from this device. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteAllDataWarning: This will permanently delete all your medications, reminders, documents, lab values, habits, and family information. This action cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteAllDataFinal: This will erase everything. There is no way to recover your data after this.
privacy.deleteSuccess: All your data has been deleted.
privacy.deleteFailed: Failed to delete data. Please try again.
privacy.disclaimer: Note: This does not delete your account or data stored in cloud backups if you've enabled those features.
